scientific_integrity: Direct signed-measure proof and reproducible exact-rational finite cross-checks; no numerical tests asserted as an infinite-dimensional proof. The sharp coefficient is exact for all positive continuous densities; the uniform equality class is classified.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional real distributional BV with two linear moments; arbitrary positive continuous densities reduce to a finite two-parameter optimization. No complex or higher-moment analogue is proved. Historical-equivalence risk remains.
title: Sharp two-moment BV-to-L2 inequalities and a weighted two-jump principle
